name: fz570_throat_chop_bounce
purpose: Magic Bounce under Throat Chop (issue 570): Incineroar, p1a, Throat Chops Hatterene, p1b, at step 4; at step 5 Incineroar, p2b, uses Parting Shot into Hatterene, whose Magic Bounce bounces it. Throat Chop's onModifyMove stops the bounced sound move in useMoveInner before the move line (data/moves.ts:19417-19422, sim/battle-actions.ts:439-445): cant|p1b: Hatterene|move: Throat Chop, no move line, and getRandomTarget's randomFoe draws one RANDOM_TARGET over the holder's standing foes first (sim/battle.ts:2490-2521). A battle of a doubles differential campaign (tools/reference/diff_driver.py random, seed 90, two Reg M-C teams, its battle 141), cut after its step 5: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
